subject: maths
prompt_en: Why must the centre of a 1-9 magic square be 5?
prompt_hi: 1-9 wale magic square ke beech mein 5 hi kyun hona chahiye?
answer: The 4 lines through the centre add to 4 × 15 = 60; they use every number once plus the centre 3 extra times, so 45 + 3 × centre = 60 and the centre is 5

subject: maths
prompt_en: Rohan says 1 5 9 / 6 7 2 / 8 3 4 is a magic square because every row and every column adds to 15. Is he right?
prompt_hi: Rohan kehta hai 1 5 9 / 6 7 2 / 8 3 4 magic square hai kyunki har row aur column ka jod 15 hai. Kya woh sahi hai?
answer: No: the diagonals are 1 + 7 + 4 = 12 and 9 + 7 + 8 = 24, so it is not magic

subject: maths
prompt_en: Make a magic square from 2, 4, 6, ..., 18 (the first nine even numbers). What is its magic sum, and what goes in the centre?
prompt_hi: 2, 4, 6, ..., 18 (pehle nau even numbers) se magic square banao. Uska magic sum kya hai, aur beech mein kya aayega?
answer: Magic sum 30 and centre 10: double every number of a 1-9 magic square

subject: maths
prompt_en: A 4 × 4 magic square carved at the Parshvanath temple in Khajuraho uses the numbers 1 to 16. What must each row add up to?
prompt_hi: Khajuraho ke Parshvanath mandir mein khuda 4 × 4 magic square 1 se 16 tak ke numbers use karta hai. Har row ka jod kitna hona chahiye?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Describe the 1-9 magic square in words: where are the odd numbers and where are the even numbers?
prompt_hi: 1-9 wale magic square ko shabdon mein batao: odd numbers kahan hain aur even kahan?
answer: Even numbers in the four corners, odd numbers in the middle of each side, and 5 in the centre

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend how to check whether a 3 × 3 grid is a magic square, step by step.
prompt_hi: Dost ko step by step sikhao ki 3 × 3 grid magic square hai ya nahi kaise check karte hain.
answer: Add each of the 3 rows, 3 columns and 2 diagonals (8 lines); it is magic only if all 8 sums are the same

subject: maths
prompt_en: From memory: how many lines must you check in a 3 × 3 magic square?
prompt_hi: Yaad se: 3 × 3 magic square mein kitni lines check karni padti hain?
answer: 8: 3 rows, 3 columns and 2 diagonals

subject: maths
prompt_en: In a magic square with sum 15, one line has 9 and 5 in it. What is the third number?
prompt_hi: Sum 15 wale magic square ki ek line mein 9 aur 5 hain. Teesra number kya hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: List all the rhythms of 4 beats.
prompt_hi: 4 beat ke saare rhythm likho.
answer: SSSS, SSL, SLS, LSS, LL: 5 rhythms

subject: maths
prompt_en: Continue the sequence: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, __, __.
prompt_hi: Sequence aage badhao: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, __, __.

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict how many rhythms have 5 beats before listing them. Then check by listing.
prompt_hi: List karne se pehle andaaza lagao ki 5 beat ke kitne rhythm hain. Phir list karke check karo.
answer: 8: SSSSS, SSSL, SSLS, SLSS, LSSS, SLL, LSL, LLS

subject: maths
prompt_en: Split the 5-beat rhythms into two groups: those starting with S and those starting with L. How many are in each group, and what do you notice?
prompt_hi: 5 beat ke rhythms ko do group mein baanto: S se shuru hone wale aur L se shuru hone wale. Har group mein kitne hain, aur kya dikhta hai?
answer: 5 start with S (the rest is a 4-beat rhythm) and 3 start with L (the rest is a 3-beat rhythm): 5 + 3 = 8

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why is the number of 6-beat rhythms equal to the number of 5-beat rhythms plus the number of 4-beat rhythms?
prompt_hi: 6 beat ke rhythms ki ginti, 5 beat aur 4 beat ke rhythms ki ginti ke jod ke barabar kyun hai?
answer: Every 6-beat rhythm starts with S, followed by any 5-beat rhythm, or with L, followed by any 4-beat rhythm; so 8 + 5 = 13

subject: maths
prompt_en: Aditya wrote the counts as 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 'because it goes up by one'. Where does his pattern break?
prompt_hi: Aditya ne ginti 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 likhi 'kyunki ek-ek badhta hai'. Uska pattern kahan tootta hai?
answer: At 4 beats: there are 5 rhythms, not 4; each count is the sum of the previous two: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13

subject: maths
prompt_en: Simran says there are only 2 rhythms of 3 beats, SSS and SL, 'because LS is the same as SL'. Is she right?
prompt_hi: Simran kehti hai 3 beat ke sirf 2 rhythm hain, SSS aur SL, 'kyunki LS aur SL same hain'. Kya woh sahi hai?
answer: No: LS (long then short) sounds different from SL, so there are 3 rhythms

subject: maths
prompt_en: You climb stairs taking 1 or 2 steps at a time. In how many ways can you climb 6 stairs?
prompt_hi: Tum seedhiyan ek baar mein 1 ya 2 karke chadhte ho. 6 seedhiyan kitne tareekon se chadh sakte ho?
answer: 13 ways, the same as the rhythms of 6 beats (8 + 5)

subject: maths
prompt_en: A batter scores 7 runs using only singles and twos, in some order. How many different orders are possible?
prompt_hi: Ek batsman sirf singles aur twos se, kisi bhi kram mein, 7 run banata hai. Kitne alag kram ho sakte hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Clap the 4-beat rhythms: a quick clap for S, a clap held for 2 beats for L. Write each one with letters and as beat numbers (like 1+1+2).
prompt_hi: 4 beat ke rhythm taali se bajao: S ke liye jaldi taali, L ke liye 2 beat ki lambi taali. Har ek ko letters mein aur beat numbers mein likho (jaise 1+1+2).

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend the rule for the next Virahanka number, and why the rule works.
prompt_hi: Dost ko agle Virahanka number ka rule sikhao, aur yeh rule kyun kaam karta hai.
answer: Add the previous two; a rhythm of n beats starts with S (then n − 1 beats remain) or L (then n − 2 beats remain)

subject: maths
prompt_en: From memory: what are the first six Virahanka numbers, starting 1, 2?
prompt_hi: Yaad se: 1, 2 se shuru karke pehle chhe Virahanka numbers kya hain?

subject: maths
prompt_en: These numbers are often called 'Fibonacci numbers'. Who described them earlier, and while studying what?
prompt_hi: In numbers ko aksar 'Fibonacci numbers' kehte hain. Inhe pehle kisne samjhaya tha, aur kya padhte hue?
answer: Virahanka, while studying rhythms (metres) of Sanskrit poetry, centuries before Fibonacci; Gopala and Hemachandra also wrote about them

subject: maths
prompt_en: Find both missing digits: □7 + 5□ = 112.
prompt_hi: Dono gaayab digit dhoondo: □7 + 5□ = 112.

subject: maths
prompt_en: If A + A = 1B and B = 4, what is A?
prompt_hi: Agar A + A = 1B aur B = 4, toh A kya hai?

subject: maths
prompt_en: In AB + CD = EFG, two 2-digit numbers make a 3-digit number. Predict what E must be before trying any numbers.
prompt_hi: AB + CD = EFG mein do 2-digit numbers milkar 3-digit number banate hain. Koi number try karne se pehle andaaza lagao E kya hoga.
answer: 1: two 2-digit numbers add to at most 99 + 99 = 198

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare 'A + B = C' (one column) with 'A + B = 1C'. What does the 1 tell you about A + B?
prompt_hi: 'A + B = C' (ek column) ko 'A + B = 1C' se compare karo. 1 se A + B ke baare mein kya pata chalta hai?
answer: In the second, A + B is 10 or more, so it spills into the tens place as a carry; in the first, A + B is 9 or less

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why can the carry from adding two digits never be 2?
prompt_hi: Do digit jodne par carry kabhi 2 kyun nahi ho sakta?
answer: The biggest case is 9 + 9 + 1 = 19, which is less than 20, so the carry is at most 1

subject: maths
prompt_en: Nikhil says AB + AB = BA has the answer A = 2, B = 4, because 24 + 24 = 42. Check him.
prompt_hi: Nikhil kehta hai AB + AB = BA ka jawab A = 2, B = 4 hai, kyunki 24 + 24 = 42. Use check karo.
answer: Wrong: 24 + 24 = 48, not 42; check the ones column: B + B must end in A

subject: maths
prompt_en: In 6□ + □8 = 121, Gauri found the first blank is 3, then said the second blank is 6 because 6 + 6 = 12. Check her answer.
prompt_hi: 6□ + □8 = 121 mein Gauri ne pehla blank 3 nikaala, phir kaha doosra blank 6 hai kyunki 6 + 6 = 12. Uska jawab check karo.
answer: She forgot the carry from the ones (3 + 8 = 11): the tens are 6 + □ + 1 = 12, so the second blank is 5, giving 63 + 58 = 121

subject: maths
prompt_en: Find one pair of digits A and B so that the 2-digit numbers AB and BA add up to 121. What do all such pairs have in common?
prompt_hi: Aise do digit A aur B dhoondo ki 2-digit numbers AB aur BA ka jod 121 ho. Aur batao, aise saare pairs mein kya common hai?
answer: Any digits with A + B = 11 work, e.g. 29 + 92 = 121 or 47 + 74 = 121; every such pair has A + B = 11

subject: maths
prompt_en: A shop bill got smudged: ₹3□5 + ₹□47 = ₹1,032. Find the smudged digits.
prompt_hi: Dukaan ka bill dhundhla ho gaya: ₹3□5 + ₹□47 = ₹1,032. Dhundhle digit dhoondo.
answer: ₹385 + ₹647 = ₹1,032, so the digits are 8 and 6

subject: maths
prompt_en: Write the puzzle '□□ + □□ = 198' (two 2-digit numbers) as a column addition and say what the digits must be.
prompt_hi: Puzzle '□□ + □□ = 198' (do 2-digit numbers) ko column addition mein likho aur batao digits kya honge.
answer: 99 + 99 = 198: every blank is 9, because 198 is the largest possible sum of two 2-digit numbers

subject: maths
prompt_en: Teach a friend three rules that help crack a letter-sum puzzle.
prompt_hi: Dost ko 3 niyam sikhao jo letter-sum puzzle todne mein madad karte hain.
answer: Same letter = same digit and different letters = different digits; carries are only 0 or 1; if the sum has an extra digit in front, it is 1; start from the ones column

subject: maths
prompt_en: From memory: two 3-digit numbers add to a 4-digit number. What must its first digit be?
prompt_hi: Yaad se: do 3-digit numbers ka jod 4-digit number hai. Uska pehla digit kya hoga?

subject: maths
prompt_en: Can sticks of 2 cm, 3 cm and 8 cm make a triangle?
prompt_hi: Kya 2 cm, 3 cm aur 8 cm ki teeliyon se triangle banega?
answer: No: 2 + 3 = 5, which is less than 8

subject: maths
prompt_en: Can sticks of 4 cm, 6 cm and 10 cm make a triangle?
prompt_hi: Kya 4 cm, 6 cm aur 10 cm ki teeliyon se triangle banega?
answer: No: 4 + 6 = 10 exactly, so it flattens into a straight line

subject: maths
prompt_en: Predict: with straws of 3 cm, 4 cm and 9 cm, will the two short straws reach each other when fixed to the ends of the long one? Then try.
prompt_hi: Andaaza lagao: 3 cm, 4 cm aur 9 cm ke straw mein, lambe straw ke dono siron par lage chhote straw kya ek doosre tak pahunchenge? Phir try karo.
answer: No: together the short ones reach only 7 cm, less than 9 cm

subject: maths
prompt_en: Compare the sides 4, 5, 9 and 4, 5, 8. Why does one make a triangle and the other not?
prompt_hi: 4, 5, 9 aur 4, 5, 8 ko compare karo. Ek se triangle kyun banta hai aur doosre se kyun nahi?
answer: 4 + 5 = 9 equals the longest side, so 4, 5, 9 lies flat; 4 + 5 = 9 is more than 8, so 4, 5, 8 makes a triangle

subject: maths
prompt_en: Why is it enough to check only that the longest side is less than the sum of the other two?
prompt_hi: Sirf yeh check karna kyun kaafi hai ki sabse lambi side baaki do ke jod se kam hai?
answer: The longest side plus any other side is automatically more than the third side, so those checks always pass; only the longest-side check can fail

subject: maths
prompt_en: Ravi checked sides 10 cm, 2 cm and 3 cm: '10 + 2 > 3, so a triangle is possible.' Is he right?
prompt_hi: Ravi ne 10 cm, 2 cm aur 3 cm check kiye: '10 + 2 > 3, toh triangle ban sakta hai.' Kya woh sahi hai?
answer: No: he checked the wrong pair; 2 + 3 = 5 is less than 10, so no triangle

subject: maths
prompt_en: To construct a triangle with sides 6 cm, 5 cm and 4 cm, you draw the 6 cm side first. What do you do next?
prompt_hi: 6 cm, 5 cm aur 4 cm ka triangle banane ke liye pehle 6 cm ki side banayi. Uske baad kya karoge?
answer: Open the compass to 5 cm and draw an arc from one end, then 4 cm from the other end; join both ends to the point where the arcs cross
